question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

Participants were ______ a meal of steak and French fries under dim light.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Served'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the** context of the sentence,** the word that fits best is** "served",** which means to present food or drink for people to have.
 
• The sentence then reads "Participants were served a meal of steak and French fries under dim light", which makes logical and grammatical sense.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"Participants were served a meal of steak and French fries under dim light".*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's go through all the options:
 
 
• **"Nerved" -** This isn't commonly used, but it generally means to give strength or courage to. (साहस देना). It doesn't fit in this sentence because you don't "nerve" someone a meal.
 
• **"Cured" - **This means to preserve (meat, fish, tobacco, or an animal skin) by various methods such as salting, drying, or smoking. (इलाज करना). It doesn't fit in this sentence because you don't "cure" someone a meal.
 
• **"Calmed" - **This means to make (someone) tranquil and quiet; soothe.(शांत करना). It doesn't fit in this sentence because you don't "calm" someone a meal.
